title: Choose Pep Club's redesigned visual world (round 3 — no blue, no glass)
question: Degraded roll (no network to the challenger service, no boards) assigned Terracotta Crucible & Mortar-Pestle — my own lowest-resonance guess of the 7 candidates. Keep it, or re-roll.

options.label: Terracotta Crucible & Mortar-Pestle
options.lineage: ancient apothecary crucible, ceramic mortar and pestle, hand-ground compounding
options.thesis: The catalog as a compounding bench — warm terracotta and ochre, every brand and vial ground and verified by hand.
options.viewport: A warm clay-toned hero: brand mark on a crucible-shaped plinth, research areas as hand-thrown ceramic tabs.
options.risk: Reads herbal/artisanal rather than clinical-precision if the type and structure don't carry real rigor — lowest resonance of my 7 for a research-chemical audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, trustworthy peptide-shop template — restrained navy/white, marketplace product grid, plain nav — done at full craft, no experimental world.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional storefront: header search + cart, hero banner, category tiles, product grid — the arrangement a visitor already expects from any online shop.
